name: Auto (European Specialist)
tagline: A dark, precise template for European auto specialists — book online from day one.
description: A precision European-import auto shop — BMW, Mercedes, Audi, Porsche and VW — in a dark graphite palette with a sharp marque-red primary. Installs a working booking flow: factory-trained master technicians you book by name, real service bays as bookable resources (a visit reserves both), and a live menu of diagnostics, scheduled maintenance, performance and pre-purchase inspection with a diagnostic-deposit policy. Ships as "Autobahn Werks" — dealer-level, without the dealer markup.
